newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan traders expect Russia Aug PGM shipments soon.
newsitem.headline: Japan traders expect Russia Aug PGM shipments soon.

text.p: Russia is expected to start shipping its August-delivery platinum group metals (PGMs) to Japan on Thursday, Japanese traders said on Tuesday.

"We were told that the agency (Almazjuvelirexport) will start shipping the August deliveries on Thursday of this week. We expect the metal here from next Monday," a senior trader at a major trading house said.
"The tightness in the physical market is expected to gradually ease," he said.
Another trading house source also said he expected Russia's August PGM shipments to commence on Thursday.
Russia resumed PGM shipments to Japan under long-term contracts in July after a six-month suspension.
Russia supplies more than 60 percent of the world's palladium and about 20 percent of its platinum. Japan is the world's largest consumer of PGMs.
